description: Record/replay script for an LJCMG CapHome enforcement search that returns ZERO records (LJCMGClient.cs:75-175 + HistoricalCrawler :81-105). form → results (single page, no data rows, no pagination anchor). Proves the empty-results stop: the callback sets crawledToEnd = true (last page) and then returns false on Results.Count == 0, so newLinks is empty, crawledToEnd is true, and pages is empty. No Chromium, no live traffic.
